list.snippet: Highest above sea level: Mount Everest in the Himalayas (Nepal and China) at 8,848.86 meters.
Tallest from base to peak: Mauna Kea in Hawaii, measuring over 33,500 feet (10,210 meters) total, with more than 6,000 meters sitting underwater on the ocean floor.
Farthest from Earth's center: Mount Chimborazo in Ecuador. Because Earth bulges at the equator, its peak sits about 6,800 feet farther from the Earth's core than Everest's summit.
